description: Figure 6(a) illustrates the distribution of datasets over time, differentiating between the five most frequent researcher locations and all other locations combined. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in yearly increments, and is treated as a categorical variable. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and employs a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10³. Tick marks are present at intervals of 10⁰, 10¹, and 10².  There are ten bars representing each year, with five bars representing the five most frequent researcher locations—colored blue, green, red, purple, and orange—and one bar representing all other locations combined, colored gray. In 2012, the gray bar representing all other locations is approximately 10⁰, while the blue bar representing the most frequent location is approximately 10¹. In 2022, the gray bar is approximately 10⁰, and the blue bar is approximately 10². The bars are arranged chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized.
